builds.name: Reference: Engage and rescue
builds.goal: Reference for Alistar: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A frontline initiator and bodyguard who chains displacement into a delayed attack stun, using his ultimate to remain in melee. Can AP repay damage from Q/W/E while preserving a real engage and R survival window? E stun needs contact and an attack; score allied follow-up separately. A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
builds.summary: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
testPlan: Kit question for Alistar: Can AP repay damage from Q/W/E while preserving a real engage and R survival window? E stun needs contact and an attack; score allied follow-up separately.

Start with the early core (Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

The route fails Alistar's stated kit question: Can AP repay damage from Q/W/E while preserving a real engage and R survival window? E stun needs contact and an attack; score allied follow-up separately.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.
Full cost 10,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Knight's Vow, Zeke's Convergence, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
